victory: Report to Command: the region answers to our codes. The other powers have received the message.
Dominion confirmed. On the Command map the region has a single colour. For now.
The Fragments have been silent for three nights. No one knows yet what they will ask of us in return.
retreat: Withdrawal carried out by the book. The spoils are safe in the Depot.
The columns are coming home. Command logs the campaign as interrupted, not lost.
The region remains contested. We will return when the sky is quieter.
eliminated: Contact lost with the front. Part of the spoils now sits in another power's depots.
The lines have fallen. The enemy is counting our equipment.
Last transmission from the front: only noise, and a song no one recognises.
timeout: The campaign's time is up. The region remains contested, the spoils return to the Depot.
End of operations. Command recalls the columns: another power holds more land than we do.
The radios fall silent at the appointed hour. Orderly withdrawal, no losses at the Depot.
